verdict.rationale: AnyDesk documents CLI-driven installation and configuration (license key, password) for use with software deployment tools across many devices, plus custom client modules generated in my.anydesk. This covers preset-configuration mass deployment. However, the evidence never shows an MSI package or MDM support, and the documented `--silent` option appears only for removal, not explicitly for installation. Missing for 10: MSI package or MDM deployment evidence, explicit silent-install parameter documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration of fleet deployment.

support.subject: As an IT admin, I can mass-deploy the client with preset configuration through MSI, MDM, or a documented silent install

citations.quote: You can use CLI commands with software deployment tools to install and configure AnyDesk on multiple devices, without manual setup on each machine.
The following example batch script installs AnyDesk, registers the license key, and sets a password
Automating tasks such as installation, licensing, password setup, and removal
You can generate and customize these modules using the custom in [my.anydesk](http://my.anydesk.com/v2).
